goal: Make the ECONOMY AuxEconomyShadow hot bundle execute independently of the SummonScout runtime anchor so a SummonScout guard cannot skip shadow/parity installation.
notes: Root cause from gameplay evidence #301/#302: ECONOMY delivered the transformed SummonScout_PostPaymentOfferHot.lua, but AH-DUMP #302 contained no marketMeta.shadowParity. The transformed host currently appends the shadow bundle after a top-level SummonScout runtime-anchor guard that can return before the bundle. Fix prepends the shadow bundle before any SummonScout guard, preserving the original host afterward. No AuxVmangos production logic, AH query scheduling, buy/bid/cancel/post primitives, transaction ownership or cutover behavior changes. Regression test asserts the final transformed host places ParityBridge and ParityExport before the SummonScout guard return.
